data.rationale: The proposal captures the generic hotel-search flow (destination, dates, guests, search, filter, open a result), but it names the wrong site (Booking.com rather than Qatar Airways), omits the Book > Hotels navigation and the sort step, and its parameters are vague (a single "dates" parameter, no sort). That makes it too imprecise to automate on the actual site.
